links.comparator_used: Zero-shot ChatGPT without few-shot examples (baseline ChatGPT diagnosis of bone tumor imaging reports)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity and specificity for benign vs malignant bone tumor classification
links.effect: Accuracy 0.73 to 0.87; sensitivity 0.95 to 0.99; specificity 0.58 to 0.73 after few-shot learning
links.quote: After few-shot learning, ChatGPT demonstrated significant improvement, achieving an accuracy of 0.87, sensitivity of 0.99, and specificity of 0.73, bringing it much closer to the level of physician diagnostics.

design_hint: few-shot prompting of an existing LLM
